# zsh-autosuggestions provenance

Wsh vendors `zsh-autosuggestions.zsh` byte for byte from [zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions](https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions) commit `85919cd1ffa7d2d5412f6d3fe437ebdbeeec4fc5`.

Wsh's unchanged source, build transformation, selected upstream mode, and exact-copy ownership policy are recorded in [`VENDORED-COMPONENTS.md`](https://github.com/wakamex/wsh/blob/main/VENDORED-COMPONENTS.md).

- Upstream path: `zsh-autosuggestions.zsh`
- SHA-256: `eec7ba8f7a71414ace0ea0fab0908d005b24cf65d83b169c0ff97815d3cfc51a`
- License: MIT, retained in `LICENSE` and in the vendored distribution file

The unchanged `known-0.7.0.zsh` reference comes from upstream commit `a411ef3e0992d4839f0732ebeb9823024afaaaa8` (v0.7.0), verified against local upstream Git objects. SHA-256: `70c34826cb110e1c54dfba85802ad3ac0144e3a2e203c41a617fd7651d43c875`. It retains the same embedded MIT license and is used only for comparison; Wsh never sources it. Recognized inactive copies use the current native controller while retaining configured values.
